chunks: And from him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad al-Sha'iri, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Choose for your offspring, for the maternal uncle is one of the two milk-relatives."

key_terms.الضَّجِيعَيْنِ: the two milk-relatives (maternal uncle and aunt)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the maternal uncle in Shia hadith regarding marriage selection?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the Shia emphasis on lineage purity and social compatibility (*kafa'ah*) in marriage, highlighting the maternal uncle (*al-khal*) as a crucial kinship figure who often plays a decisive role in family alliances. By identifying the uncle as one of the 'two bedfellows' (implying close, enduring companionship or primary relatives), the text reinforces the significance of maternal lineage in determining marital suitability and social cohesion within the family structure.
